Data Driven Football — https://datadrivenfootball.github.io/fantasy-tools/
As of: 2026-11-06
Settings: half_ppr, 12 teams, roster QB1 RB2 WR3 TE1 FLEX1 BENCH6
Week: 9 (the site's default).

Health check: 1 of 7 checks flagged. Value pie 2688 points, 7 sources.
PASS | Starter totals | All 7 sources agree (spread 4.6%, limit 17%).
PASS | RB, WR and TE starters | RB 4.4%, WR 8.3%, TE 3.9%: all within the 24% limit.
INFO | QB starters | Spread 4.8% (FantasyPros high, CBS rest of season low). Expected; never flagged.
INFO | Bench totals | Spread 55.7%. Expected: sources price bench differently.
FLAG | Totals vs the value pie | CBS rest of season, all positions: adds up to 2686.7, not the value pie 2688.0.
PASS | Filled-in players | At most 45% of any position's slots filled in (limit 75%).
PASS | Player values vs DDF Value | Projections add up to the value pie, and charts match DDF Value on the players they list.

Open this on the site: Values auditing (health check and each source's build-up).
https://datadrivenfootball.github.io/fantasy-tools/#values-auditing?scoring=half_ppr&teams=12&roster=QB1.RB2.WR3.TE1.FLEX1.SF0.BN6&v=1
